context: Two cafe friends gossip about relationships
purpose: Teach: ギャップ/育ち/不信/浮気/大騒ぎ/おいしかっ/おいしく/怒る

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日のディナー、彼との会話のギャップに驚いた。
lines.en: Last night at dinner, I was struck by how much we weren't on the same page.
lines.style: Quiet, searching. Exhales the weight of it on 'dinner.' Hesitant, like she's still processing the hurt. Gentle downslope at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 育ちが違うと、価値観も違うよね。
lines.en: Growing up in different worlds—it shapes how you see things, doesn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, understanding nod in the voice. Not lecturing—recognizing. Warm acknowledgment of something true. Slight pause before the question, like inviting her to sit with the idea.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 浮気の噂もあるみたいで、ちょっと不信に陥ってる。
lines.en: And there are these rumors about him seeing someone else. I don't know what to believe.
lines.style: Tremor of vulnerability underneath. Words come slower. Slight break on 'someone else'—testing how it sounds out loud. Trailing into uncertainty.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 怒るより、事実確認が先よ。
lines.en: Get the facts straight first. Getting angry can wait.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Clear-eyed practicality. Leans forward slightly in the voice—not unkind, but cutting through. Matter-of-fact and grounding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日のパスタは、おいしかったから救われた気がする。
lines.en: The pasta was so good, though. That part at least didn't disappoint me.
lines.style: Small, almost-laugh in the voice. Finding the smallest solid thing to hold onto. Wry but not bitter—just tired recognition that even bad nights have one good bite.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今度、私がおいしく淹れたコーヒーで、大騒ぎせず話し合おう。
lines.en: Next time, sit down over coffee I've made—good coffee—and just talk. No drama, no running away from it.
lines.style: Warm, gentle offer. Speaks from her own knowing—the safety of ritual, of presence. The 'good coffee' is both literal and a small metaphor for care. Steady and true.
